company.name: True Anomaly
company.shortDescription: True Anomaly develops space security technologies, including spacecraft, software platforms, and mission systems for orbital operations.
company.description: True Anomaly develops space security technologies, including spacecraft, software platforms, and mission systems for orbital operations. The company builds satellites and autonomous systems that support monitoring, maneuvering, and coordination in space environments. Its offerings include simulation tools and mission planning software that help operators model scenarios and manage on-orbit activities. The organization also provides hardware and integrated systems that enable responsive deployment and control of space assets. Its work focuses on supporting government and commercial missions that require situational awareness and operational capabilities beyond Earth.

aiResearchSummary.text: True Anomaly is engaged in research and development of modular spacecraft bus systems, as described in 'Modular spacecraft bus system and associated methods.' The abstract details a spacecraft bus system comprising a propulsion assembly, top plate assembly, and bottom plate assembly, each designed for separate assembly and spaceworthiness testing. This work highlights True Anomaly’s focus on modular spacecraft architecture to support space security and resilience.
